android.//usesCleartextTraffic: An Audiobookshelf server on the LAN is reached over plain http, and Android blocks cleartext by default, so a connect attempt fails at the socket with no useful error. This opens it for the whole app because the manifest cannot say otherwise: usesCleartextTraffic is all or nothing, and a network security config takes hostnames and IP literals rather than address ranges, so "http only on a private network" cannot be expressed for an address the listener types in. It is enforced in the app instead - isCleartextToPublicHost in src/lib/abs/client.ts refuses every request to a plain-http public address before it is sent. See docs/STATE.md.

plugins.photosPermission: Due Back needs your photos only to let you pick a cover for a book whose artwork is missing or wrong.
